reviewed_invariants: Journal::open completes all chunk hashes, byte counts, identities, sequence, parent and full retained-legacy-prefix validation before Runtime replay or RPC construction.
Only authenticated ChunkRefs and compact tail persist in v2 Archive; each reader retains one payload chunk and revalidates its exact predecessor ref.
Replay returns callback errors immediately without later callbacks or mutation; Runtime preserves its per-block shutdown checkpoint.
Historical time and duplicate lookups verify matching committed chunk bytes, binary-search actual slots, and return None for skipped slots; duplicates compare full block payload equality.

New suffix rejects rollback/gap/fork/unfinalized blocks; metadata capacity is reserved before persistence; head/index/tail install only after durable commit; uncertain persistence still poisons writes.
Existing v1 format and storage behavior remain; metrics and catch-up use validated tail; fee/expiry planning uses fallible historical block-time lookup.
limitations: Existing synchronous Journal::open validation remains non-cancellable mid-validation; runtime cancellation is checked before open and per replayed block, unchanged.
ChunkRefs and Indexer accepted-block digest history still grow with history; Scanner clones remain; this is not a fixed-total-memory or long-term disk capacity guarantee.
Nominal32MiB payload chunks preserve the existing oversized-singleton exception.
The cold path reads legacy bytes and chunks multiple times to retain complete validation before replay; host timing/RSS require separate observation.
